statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. Earlier releases put the :CVE ontology label, with its _ont_* fields, on every PACKAGE_VULNERABILITY AWSInspectorFinding, and CVEMetadata enriched each one. The CVE is now the AWSInspectorVulnerability the finding links to, and nothing updates these any more, so strip them: left stale, :CVE queries count each Inspector CVE once per affected resource. The ENRICHES edge goes in the same batch, because CVEMetadata cleanup matches :CVE targets and cannot reach it once the label is gone. Scoped to the findings of the account that just completed its sync, whose findings all link to their AWSInspectorVulnerability. The scan starts from the :CVE label, which loses every finding a batch migrates, so a rerun never walks a migrated finding again. Starting from the account instead walks all of its findings on every run, which is quadratic in the account's finding count. Idempotent: once stripped, no AWSInspectorFinding carries :CVE or an ENRICHES edge.
statements.query: MATCH (f:AWSInspectorFinding:CVE) WHERE EXISTS { (f)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount {id: $AWS_ID}) } WITH f LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (f) { OPTIONAL MATCH (f)<-[r:ENRICHES]-(:CVEMetadata) DELETE r REMOVE f:CVE, f._ont_source, f._ont_cve_id, f._ont_base_score, f._ont_base_severity, f._ont_description, f._ont_references } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. Earlier releases also wrote the CVE _ont_* fields on network reachability and code findings, which never carried :CVE. Those are few, so one pass removes them.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount {id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(f:AWSInspectorFinding) WHERE f.type <> 'PACKAGE_VULNERABILITY' AND f._ont_source IS NOT NULL REMOVE f._ont_source, f._ont_cve_id, f._ont_base_score, f._ont_base_severity, f._ont_description, f._ont_references

name: AWS Inspector - migrate CVE labels written by earlier versions
